scope: Mechanical immutable author checkpoint only; not a new review, complete figure gate, approval, certified PASS or promotion.

provenancePolicy.statement: Paths within copied historical records, specs, manifests and command outputs are archival provenance only. No retained artifact requires a .tmp or ROOT tmp path at runtime. RetainedRelativePath and SHA-256 are the checkpoint bindings; originals are preserved, not relocated or deleted.

execution.operation: regular-file blind copy and raw SHA-256 binding only
